title: Clarify hidden review-result history during domain binding and bound-parent review submission
outcome: Domain enrollment reports bounded, understandable history diagnostics and explicitly defines hidden structured-review-result control mail versus routine domain mail, without migrating or adopting existing history.
acceptance: Document and implement whether hidden review-result mailbox rows block a raw-to-qualified binding transition, with design concurrence.
The refusal reports total history count and a bounded set of mailbox references, explaining hidden control rows without bodies.
Review-result submissions to bound parents have an explicit guarded route or documented control-channel exemption, with regression coverage.
